name: Nakanishi Kyuudou
source:
"I've got just a little bit closer to Sis's level... I think" 


 A student at Seijou School, belonging to the kyuudou club. The younger sister of Nakanishi Kendou. A complete contrast to her outgoing older sister, she's humble and extremely shy, a very introverted girl. 

 Battle quote - "My arrows fly straight and true... i, if you come close you'll get shot!"
[From [url=http://alicesoft.wikia.com/wiki/]Alice Soft wiki[/url]]
